origin: Original practice stimulus; reviewed axis/unit derivation

data.unit_rule: Vertical-axis unit divided by horizontal-axis unit; angle/count ratios may be dimensionless.
data.model_limit: Idealised practice data only. Do not infer that every real dataset is exact, that every line passes through the origin, or that the gradient is automatically a familiar constant.

gradient_meaning: The slope is the measured change in pull per current over this limited illustrative range, 2 N/A. The 0.1 N intercept can include a force-gauge zero offset; it is not a universal force law.
aim: test electromagnet pull as current changes at fixed geometry
arrangement: An insulated coil on a soft-iron core, current-limited low-voltage supply, ammeter, force gauge and the same steel target
